SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS open_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN sla_breach_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??Z' THEN SUBSTR(sla_breach_at, 1, 19) || '.000000' WHEN sla_breach_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??+00:00' THEN SUBSTR(sla_breach_at, 1, 19) || '.000000' ELSE (SUBSTR(sla_breach_at, 1, 19) || '.' || SUBSTR(SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(sla_breach_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', ''), 21) || '000000', 1, 6)) END) <= '2026-09-26T07:11:24.883105' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS sla_breached_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN assigned_reviewer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS unassigned_count
        FROM submissions

SELECT
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN decided_n >= '2026-09-19T07:11:24.883105' AND decided_n <= '2026-09-26T07:11:24.883105' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS completed_last_7_days,
          AVG(CASE WHEN decided_n >= '2026-08-27T07:11:24.883105' AND decided_n <= '2026-09-26T07:11:24.883105'
            AND decided_n >= submitted_n
            THEN (julianday(decided_n) - julianday(submitted_n))
            ELSE NULL END)
            AS avg_turnaround_days,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN decided_n >= '2026-08-27T07:11:24.883105' AND decided_n <= '2026-09-26T07:11:24.883105'
            AND decided_n >= submitted_n THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS turnaround_sample_size
        FROM (
          SELECT
            (CASE WHEN decided_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??Z' THEN SUBSTR(decided_at, 1, 19) || '.000000' WHEN decided_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??+00:00' THEN SUBSTR(decided_at, 1, 19) || '.000000' ELSE (SUBSTR(decided_at, 1, 19) || '.' || SUBSTR(SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', ''), 21) || '000000', 1, 6)) END) AS decided_n,
            (CASE WHEN submitted_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??Z' THEN SUBSTR(submitted_at, 1, 19) || '.000000' WHEN submitted_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??+00:00' THEN SUBSTR(submitted_at, 1, 19) || '.000000' ELSE (SUBSTR(submitted_at, 1, 19) || '.' || SUBSTR(SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(submitted_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', ''), 21) || '000000', 1, 6)) END) AS submitted_n
          FROM submissions
